summary: Completed comprehensive regression testing after code-quality refactors. All 16 backend tests passed (372 laws, pagination, filters, maturity computation, admin CRUD, chat streaming with enriched responses). Frontend smoke test confirmed all major features working: Explore maps, Browse with filters/search/load-more, Timeline, Compare, Assistant streaming, theme toggle, and 'Last verified' badge in law details.

design_issues.issue: Console warnings about missing DialogTitle for accessibility (Radix UI)
design_issues.note: Not breaking functionality, just accessibility warnings
